newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-INDIA OUT TO MAKE AMENDS FOR ASIA CUP DEFEAT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA OUT TO MAKE AMENDS FOR ASIA CUP DEFEAT.

text.p: India, smarting from their eight-wicket thrashing by Sri Lanka in the Asia Cup final, will be out to make amends in the first of two tests between the two countries starting on Saturday.
While admitting his side were second best to the world champions in the Asia Cup, India captain Sachin Tendulkar said test cricket was "an altogether different ball game".
India, who have lost to Sri Lanka only once in their 14 clashes in tests, are expected to adopt an attacking ploy by naming five bowlers.
Nilesh Kulkarni will make his test debut, joining India's spin attack of Anil Kumble and Rajesh Chauhan. Venkatesh Prasad and Abey Kuruvila will spearhead the new ball attack.
Wicketkeeper Nayan Mongia is expected to open the batting with Navjot Sidhu.
Sri Lanka will bring in 20-year-old right-hand batsman Mahela Jayawardena for the injured Hashan Tillekeratne.
They are also trying out a new opening combination by asking Marvan Atapattu to partner Sanath Jayasuriya. Roshan Mahanama, Jayasuriya's usual partner, will bat at number three.
Sri Lanka have opted to play with two seamers and two spinners.
Chaminda Vaas returns after injury forced him out of the Caribbean tour to share the new ball with Ravindra Pushpakumara.
Left-arm spinner Jayantha Silva has been recalled ahead of Kumara Dharmasena to partner leading spinner Muthiah Muralitharan.

Sri Lanka (from) - Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya, Marvan Atapattu, Roshan Mahanama, Aravinda de Silva, Mahela Jayawardena, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Chaminda Vaas, Ravindra Pushpakumara, Muthiah Muralitharan, Jayantha Silva, Sajeeva de Silva, Kumara Dharmasena.

India (from) - Sachin Tendulkar (captain), Navjot Sidhu, Nayan Mongia, Rahul Dravid, Mohammad Azharuddin, Saurav Ganguly, Anil Kumble, Rajesh Chauhan, Venkatesh Prasad, Abey Kuruvila, Nilesh Kulkarni, Ajay Jadeja, Gagan Khoda.
Umpires: Kandiah Francis (Sri Lanka) and Steve Randall (Australia).
